definition.en: A CDG interface type: a helical ridge that converts rotation into axial travel and clamping force, letting two parts join and separate repeatedly without a fastener. Threads are the commons' most standardized interface — a cartridge that declares a real designation (M22×1, 1/4-20 UNC, PCO 1881) mates with hardware nobody in the commons had to draw.
definition.es: Tipo de interfaz CDG: un filete helicoidal que convierte la rotación en avance axial y fuerza de apriete, permitiendo que dos piezas se unan y se separen repetidamente sin herraje adicional. Las roscas son la interfaz más normalizada del procomún: un cartucho que declara una designación real (M22×1, 1/4-20 UNC, PCO 1881) acopla con herrajes que nadie del procomún tuvo que dibujar.
definition.fr: Type d'interface CDG : un filet hélicoïdal qui convertit la rotation en déplacement axial et en force de serrage, permettant à deux pièces de s'assembler et de se séparer à répétition sans visserie ajoutée. Le filetage est l'interface la plus normalisée des communs : une cartouche qui déclare une désignation réelle (M22×1, 1/4-20 UNC, PCO 1881) s'accouple à une quincaillerie que personne dans les communs n'a eu à dessiner.
definition.pt: Tipo de interface CDG: um filete helicoidal que converte a rotação em avanço axial e força de aperto, permitindo que duas peças se unam e se separem repetidamente sem ferragem adicional. As roscas são a interface mais normalizada do comum: um cartucho que declara uma designação real (M22×1, 1/4-20 UNC, PCO 1881) acopla com ferragens que ninguém no comum teve de desenhar.

aliases.name: thread
aliases.note: geometry_type value; 30 declared interfaces across the catalog.

constraints: A printed thread needs a clearance parameter of its own: the designation fixes the nominal geometry, and a cartridge that prints to nominal binds in every material that shrinks — which is why the commons' thread cartridges pair a thread_std with a clearance rather than a single dimension.
sources: ASME B1.1 — Unified Inch Screw Threads
ISO 68-1 — ISO general purpose screw threads: basic profile
